description: This file defines API endpoints for managing bookings in a pickleball court booking system. It includes creation, retrieval, joining, listing, and deletion of bookings, along with business logic such as group size rules and conflicts. It uses FastAPI and interacts with a database abstraction for persistence.

methods.name: BookingPublic create_booking(payload: BookingCreate, current: UserPublic = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new booking with specified parameters, validating input and overlapping rules.

methods.name: list[BookingPublic] list_my_bookings(current: UserPublic = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns a list of bookings for the current authenticated user.

methods.name: BookingPublic get_booking(booking_id: int = Path(..., description="Booking identifier"))
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific booking by ID.

methods.name: JoinBookingResponse join_booking( booking_id: int = Path(..., description="Booking identifier"), current: UserPublic = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Allows a user to join an existing booking, updating its status if the group is complete.

methods.name: None delete_booking( booking_id: int = Path(..., description="Booking identifier"), current: UserPublic = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Deletes a booking if the current user is the owner or an admin.

methods.name: BookingPublic _to_public(b: dict)
methods.description: Internal helper function to map internal booking representations to public API schema.
